HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Extreme worm's-eye from the current: Kangrim thrashing mid-ford in the Red River, mouth full of mud-water, body raw and violent against the flow — red-brown water as one hard colour plane. Face ONLY from attached mortal Kangrim portrait, gaunt and snarling. ONE device: the waterline as a diagonal slash. Three rivers behind him implied as pale bands in haze. Day storm light, one shaft. Hex #4a4a58 in wet-steel catch on a travel knife at his belt. No text. No watermark.
